# SkyWest Airlines

> > SkyWest Airlines is a regional carrier operating flights for major partners including American Airlines, United Express, and Delta Air Lines with a modern fleet of CRJ and E175 aircraft.

SkyWest Airlines is a major regional airline based in St. George, Utah, serving as a key partner carrier for major U.S. airlines. The site provides information for passengers, job seekers, media, and investors across flight operations, customer service, and career opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Regional Carrier
- American Airlines Partner
- United Express
- Delta Air Lines
- CRJ Aircraft Fleet
- E175 Aircraft
- Pilot Jobs
- Career Guides
- FAA Certification
- Customer Service
- Baggage Policy
- Flight Attendant Positions
- Aircraft Maintenance
- Airport Operations
- Airline Operations

## Passenger Services

- [Fly SkyWest](https://skywest.com/fly-skywest-airlines): Main flight booking and reservation page for SkyWest Airlines customers
- [Customer Information](https://skywest.com/fly-skywest-airlines/customer-information): Customer service info including baggage policy, travel restrictions, pet travel, and special needs accommodations

## Careers & Employment

- [Careers Home](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs): Main careers page with job opportunities and employee benefits information
- [Pilot Jobs](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs/career-guides/pilot-jobs): Career guide for SkyWest pilot positions with requirements and benefits details
- [Pilot Pathway Program](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs/career-guides/pilot-pathway-program): Pilot Pathway Program guide with seniority benefits and mentorship opportunities
- [Flight Attendant Jobs](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs/career-guides/flight-attendant-jobs): Career guide for flight attendant positions including requirements and interview information
- [A&P Mechanic](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs/career-guides/a-and-p-mechanic): Career guide for aircraft maintenance A&P mechanic positions at SkyWest
- [Avionics Technician](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs/career-guides/avionics): Career guide for avionics technician roles on SkyWest CRJ aircraft
- [Flight Dispatcher](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs/career-guides/dispatch): Career guide for flight dispatcher positions with FAA certification requirements
- [Crew Support](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs/career-guides/crew-support): Career guide for crew support and scheduling positions at SkyWest
- [Airport Operations Agent](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs/career-guides/airport-operations-agent): Career guide for airport operations and ground staff positions at SkyWest
- [Corporate Positions](https://skywest.com/skywest-airline-jobs/career-guides/corporate): Career guide for corporate headquarters positions in St. George, Utah

## Company Information

- [Home](https://skywest.com): SkyWest Airlines homepage with company overview, partnerships, and careers information
